rule: A comparison is one difference (one reader minus another, or one reader's score under one condition minus under another) on one population. It is counted once for each metric a sentence distinguishes (the pooled AUROC and the matched score); where a sentence names no metric, or names none apart, the difference counts once. A reader named in a group counts once per reader; states named separately count separately. A comparison named in several sentences counts once. Only sentences that apply 'reliable' or 'reliably' (or deny it) to a comparison enter; the two definition sentences of Section 4 do not. The list is keyed to sentence fragments; port_r139.py counts only the entries whose fragment is in the final main text and asserts that every main-text sentence carrying 'reliab' is covered, so a payer that deletes a sentence deletes its comparisons.
families: the registered model-minus-lookup families hold five readers each (default summary, sibling-name control, padded set, paraphrase set) and three under the all-states summary (mini, Haiku, Opus)
